title: Golden Grahams S'mores Bars: Easy, No Bake, Gooey Delight - NewsBreak
text: Enjoy all the gooey, chocolatey goodness of campfire s’mores—no fire needed! These No Bake Smores Bars with Golden Grahams are a fun, easy dessert perfect for BBQs, school events, or anytime your sweet tooth strikes. With crunchy cereal, melty chocolate, and soft marshmallows, they deliver classic s’mores flavor—minus the mess. I don’t know about you, but I’m absolutely s’mores-obsessed. While nothing beats the classic campfire treat, there’s something magical about turning those gooey, chocolatey flavors into fun new desserts—like S’mores Cookies, S’mores Brownies, or even a S’mores Trifle. But when I want something quick, easy, and no oven required, I whip up these no bake s’mores bars with Golden Grahams. They’re made with crunchy cereal, melty milk chocolate chips, and gooey mini marshmallows—everything you love about s’mores in a chewy, make-ahead cereal bar.
